note: A live run through the real HTTP API on an AI-generated face (YouCam text-to-image), not a real person. Calibration used brightness and zoom variants of that face; the new check-in is the same face rotated 3 degrees, so the skin did not change. The agent stopped on a pore 'worsening' of 4.6 points because rotation was not part of the calibration noise: a limitation of calibrating with synthetic variants, and the reason real same-day retakes are required.
